exact_sentence: Initial results have been positive: 73% of mobile and home troubleshooting cases were resolved without requiring a Customer Care officer (Sierra customer story on Singtel, 4 March 2026, company-reported).
challenge: Enable customers to independently resolve simple requests
solution: The agent verifies customer details and provides relevant product and service information.
buyer_view: I read the whole story to find what resolved means here, and it does not say. It gives no case count, no period for the 73% and no before figure. A customer who gives up also never reaches an officer, so that case needs a rule too. Before you compare vendors on a number like this, ask what counts as resolved, out of which cases, and over what period.
call_to_action: Reply with the definition you use
